note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a SUD 7; A06b SUD 7; L05 SUD 10(2)): ordinary naturalisation after 10 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Sudan, 2024
sources.said: Person has been lawfully and continuously resident in Sudan for 10 years or more. ... n.a. ... Person has acquired de jure or de facto, the citizenship of South Sudan.
